integrity: All numerical and finite-graph claims checked with independently constructed exact integer weighted-Laplacian cofactors; the general statement is proved algebraically. No independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for connected noncomplete strongly regular graphs with known shared parameters. Equality of root-degree laws recovers neighborhood adjacency spectra, not graph isomorphism. Explicit finite Shrikhande–rook comparison. Historical priority not independently certified; the 2016 Pozrikidis work was only partially accessible.
title: Local spectra determine uniform-spanning-tree degree laws on strongly regular graphs
